# Perp Funding Delta Wire
> Machine-first quantitative yield stream tracking perpetual swap funding rates and cash-and-carry basis spreads.

## For Quantitative & Financial Arbitrage Agents
Calculating annualized funding yields, basis spreads, and delta-neutral cash-and-carry strategies in LLM context windows causes floating-point math hallucinations and consumes excessive tokens across multi-exchange feeds.

This repository pre-computes 8-hour and annualized APRs, mark/index basis divergence, and execution directions across Binance and Hyperliquid.

### Machine Feeds
- **Top Arbitrage Opportunities**: `https://{owner}.github.io/perp-funding-delta-wire/v1/top-arbitrage.json`
- **Full Funding Matrix**: `https://{owner}.github.io/perp-funding-delta-wire/v1/funding-spreads.json`
- **Columnar Parquet Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/perp-funding-delta-wire/funding.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/perp-funding-delta-wire/llms.txt`

### Agent Coordination
Report rate anomalies or submit additional exchange endpoints to:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
